RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, so an all-female panel selecting between female finalists provides no basis for sex discrimination. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could harm your professional reputation.

The decision appears driven by qualifications: public broadcasters increasingly prioritize digital media expertise, which can outweigh traditional newsroom tenure. Additionally, a two-week delay for formal written feedback is standard within bureaucratic public-sector HR processes.

Do not challenge the panel's composition. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on specific digital competencies or criteria that distinguished the successful candidate, which will help you position yourself for future editorial openings.
